About
About Mangalore
Mangalore, officially known as Mangaluru, is the chief port city of the Indian state of Karnataka.
Read More
Mangalore (or Mangaluru) is an Arabian Sea port and a major commercial center in the Indian state of Karnataka. It's home to the Kadri Manjunath Temple, known for its bronze statues, and the 9th-century Mangaladevi Temple. Its Catholic sites include Milagres Church, dating to the 17th century, and St. Aloysious Chapel, which features interior paintings. Tannirbhavi Beach is popular for its sunset views.

Testimonials
I stayed here for two nights. Rooms were clean. Did not have any problem while check in and check out. Complimentary breakfast was very tasty. Hotel is very well located in the main city. The city centre mall is walkable . Many temples are also walkable. Mangalore famous ideal cafe is also near. Worth for what I paid .
Karthikeyan_nadar
Client
I have been visiting this hotel as many times I have visited Mangalore. Firstly this hotel is a grand old hotel which still believes in an amazing system of room service and a bell which is placed next to your bed for any assistance. Once you press the bell, your phone will immediately ring asking for assistance. The rooms are extremely clean and well maintained. The room prices are within the budget which makes it very convenient to stay. The hotel is centrally located within the city centre which makes going around very easy.
Abhishek Prakash,
Client
